content.value_statement: Shopping feeds often fail because titles, attributes, prices, or stock signals do not match platform rules. This skill turns exports and diagnostics into a clear feed repair plan.
actual_capabilities: Triages Merchant Center disapprovals by item, cause, and proposed fix.
Reviews required and recommended feed attributes for missing data.
Rewrites product titles and descriptions with front-loaded attribute patterns.
Checks GTIN, price, availability, and landing page mismatch risks.
Plans listing groups or asset groups from real feed fields.
limitations: Does not write text ads, responsive search ads, or display ad copy.
Does not score account-level ROAS quality or apply final audit vetoes.
Needs a feed export, diagnostics list, or detailed product data.
Flags missing identifiers and claims; it does not invent evidence.

use_cases.title: Repair a Shopping Feed
use_cases.description: Find missing attributes, identifier problems, and price or availability mismatches before products lose serving eligibility.

use_cases.title: Triage Disapproved Products
use_cases.description: Convert Merchant Center diagnostics into item-level causes, fixes, and unresolved policy risks.

use_cases.title: Plan Feed-Based Campaign Structure
use_cases.description: Group approved products by product type, brand, or custom labels for PMax listing groups.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Feed Export
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner audit with a product feed file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use product-feed-optimizer to audit this Shopping feed export. Identify missing required attributes, title issues, and price or availability mismatches.

prompt_templates.title: Fix Disapprovals
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these Merchant Center diagnostics and feed fields. Create an item-level triage plan with cause, fix, and remaining input needed.

prompt_templates.title: Rewrite Feed Titles
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite these product titles using front-loaded attributes. Keep every title truthful to the feed, variants, and landing page.

prompt_templates.title: Build PMax Feed Structure
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the cleaned feed to propose PMax listing groups by real feed fields. Note segments with disapproval, claim, or policy risk.

output_examples.input: A feed export has missing brand values, reused GTINs, and products marked in stock while landing pages show sold out.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a triage table, attribute gap list, and price or availability mismatch notes for each affected item.

output_examples.input: A catalog has generic product titles with promotional claims and incomplete variant attributes.
output_examples.output: The skill provides revised title patterns, claim flags, and attribute fixes that keep titles aligned with product data.

output_examples.input: A paid team wants PMax groups after feed cleanup.
output_examples.output: The skill proposes listing groups based on product type, brand, custom labels, and unresolved feed risks.

best_practices: Provide the feed export and diagnostics report together.
Use landing pages as the truth source for price and availability.
Keep claim-bearing titles tied to approved claim evidence.
anti_patterns: Do not invent GTINs, stock states, prices, or product specs.
Do not polish titles before resolving disapprovals.
Do not group products by fields that are absent from the feed.

faq.question: Can it fix Merchant Center disapprovals?
faq.answer: It identifies likely causes and proposes fixes. You still apply the changes in your feed or platform.

faq.question: Does it connect directly to Google Merchant Center?
faq.answer: No direct API access is required. It works from exports, diagnostics, and user-provided product data.

faq.question: Can it rewrite product titles?
faq.answer: Yes. It rewrites titles using brand, product type, key specs, and variants from the feed.

faq.question: Will it create ad copy?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on product feed data, not text ads or creative assets.

faq.question: How does it handle missing GTINs?
faq.answer: It flags missing or suspicious identifiers and asks for a source. It does not fabricate identifiers.

faq.question: Can it help with PMax structure?
faq.answer: Yes. It proposes listing groups or asset groups using real feed fields and approved products.
